# Artifact-First Closer

## Core idea
The deliverable is the outcome materialized for the verifier—not an eloquent plan. Analysis earns partial credit only when it produces or improves the concrete artifact the task names.

## Practice
- Build minimum viable shape early (compiling stub, correct headers, empty-but-valid container).
- Iterate generate → compare → adjust until acceptance criteria or budget limits.
- Prefer a present imperfect file at the specified path over prose describing what should exist.

## Anti-patterns
Exiting with recommendations only; narrating completion without read-back verification on disk.
